caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a dark brown to black color tone, featuring ornate carvings on the backrest and decorative elements on the legs and seat edge. The chair’s back includes a central, shield-shaped carved panel, framed by two vertical supports and a top rail with additional carved detailing. The seat is slightly angled, with its front edge having a carved, undulating outline. The four legs of the chair are turned, with the two front legs more elaborately shaped than the rear, which are straighter. Stretchers connect the legs, adding stability and a decorative touch. The drawing is set against a plain, beige background, with no other objects present. At the bottom of the image, the name “Violet Hartenstein” is printed in small, red letters.
title: Youth's Chair
